description: This file contains shell script code that provides helper functions and commands for managing Docker containers related to OpenClaw, including starting, stopping, configuring, and interacting with the OpenClaw Docker environment.

methods.name: _clr_cmd
methods.description: Styled output function for commands, outputs text in green and bold.

methods.name: _cmd
methods.description: Inline command function for use in sentences, outputs text in green and bold.

methods.name: _clawdock_filter_warnings
methods.description: Filters out warning and timing lines from command output.

methods.name: _clawdock_trim_quotes
methods.description: Removes surrounding quotes from a string.

methods.name: _clawdock_mask_value
methods.description: Masks or redacts a value, indicating length or redacting sensitive info.

methods.name: _clawdock_read_config_dir
methods.description: Reads the configuration directory path from the config file.

methods.name: _clawdock_ensure_dir
methods.description: Ensures the CLAWDOCK_DIR is set and points to a valid Docker compose directory, with auto-detection if not set.

methods.name: _clawdock_compose
methods.description: Runs docker compose commands with the appropriate files based on the CLAWDOCK_DIR.

methods.name: _clawdock_read_env_token
methods.description: Reads the gateway token from the environment file in the CLAWDOCK directory.
